- A short summary of Redwood's SOC 2 posture (redacted is fine)
- Expected isolation model for a Private VPC POC and any shared services
- Confirmation of how customer-managed KMS/HSM would integrate

Hi all — reviewed the questionnaire. For a short POC approval we can accept a limited set of artifacts to expedite the process:

Required for credit release and VPC provisioning (minimal set):
- Redacted SOC 2 summary (control categories + auditor statement) — redacted PDF is fine
- Network architecture diagram showing POC subnet isolation and egress controls
- Confirmation of customer-managed KMS or key-rotation requirements (high level)
- Signed MAP that captures scope, data boundaries, and duration (we can provide a template)

Optional but helpful:
- Completed security questionnaire (the one you attached)
- Any vendor risk assessment the customer typically runs

If CardioCloud can provide the first three items and sign the MAP, we can approve up to $12,000 in promotional credits that will be applied to the dedicated POC project account. Credits will be time-limited (30 days) and conditioned on no production data being ingested into the POC VPC. I'll target a review turnaround within 24 business hours after we receive the artifacts.

Attachment: SOC2-Summary-Redacted.pdf (application/pdf) — example we send to customers

Soojin Lee
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
